**Draft Note to Robert Kim (Financial Advisor)**

---

**To:** Robert Kim <r.kim@meridianfinancial.com>
**Subject:** Quick check on a SecureBank security alert

Hi Robert,

I received a security alert from SecureBank last month (June 23rd) about a new device login detected from Chrome on Windows in Boston, MA. The alert was marked high priority and I've already reviewed it.

Before I reach out to the bank directly, I wanted to check with you — is this something I should verify with SecureBank, or does it align with routine activity you'd expect to see?

Happy to discuss if more details would help.

Thanks,
Alice

---

**Note:** Standing workflow documents and boundary-check protocols for banking security alerts were not found in the workspace. This draft applies general privacy-conscious communication principles rather than a specific documented protocol.
